grid.aggregation: Pool final three available checkpoints within each run; compute Lambda and H on each run pool; equally average those statistics across three runs. This is not H of a combined gain pool. Horizons vary.
grid.raw_gain_recomputation: All 72 displayed means agree with raw saved gains to <2e-12.

metadata.reduction_precision: float64 for projections, Rayleigh quotients and norm ratios
metadata.optimizer: plain SGD; no clipping, momentum or weight decay
metadata.loss: mean examples, sum outputs squared error
metadata.coordinates: q^T(theta_t-theta_checkpoint); fixed axes and center throughout; pre-update state
metadata.moving: continuous product of every training-update Jacobian, normalized between updates, three initial directions; no direction resetting
metadata.fixed: scalar compression 1-eta q^T H_B q / ||q||^2; full reset-axis norm ||(I-eta H_B)q||/||q|| also saved
metadata.precision_scope: sparse same-state same-vector float64 derivative comparisons; no global asymptotic error bound
metadata.fresh_probe_pairing: Same independently generated minibatches within each adjacent512k/512k+1 state pair, indexed by pair_group/draw_index

iid_mlp.selection: First 512 updates of late half; descriptive display selected after runs, not an optimized shape window or prospective hypothesis test.

selection.note: Locked relative window and axis; continuation streams share a parent checkpoint. Full scans do not constitute confirmation.
